answer.worked:
The container radius is $10\div2=5\mathrm{cm}$, matching the cheese radius.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Cheeses per layer} &= 360^\circ\div45^\circ\\\text{Cheeses per layer} &= 8\\\text{Number of layers} &= 4\div2\\\text{Number of layers} &= 2\\\text{Total mini-cheeses} &= 2\times8\\\text{Total mini-cheeses} &= 16\end{align*}$$
